description: This Java class 'MessageDeserializer' provides static methods for deserializing Message objects from JSON representations, including handling message headers, payloads, and content type interpretation.

classes.name: MessageDeserializer
classes.description: Utility class for deserializing Message objects from JSON, including handling headers, payloads, and content type interpretation.

methods.name: deserializeMessageFromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a Message object from its JSON representation, extracting headers and payload.

methods.name: deserializeMessageFromHeadersAndPayload
methods.description: Constructs a Message object from given headers and payload, interpreting payload based on content type.

methods.name: shouldBeInterpretedAsTextOrJson
methods.description: Determines if the message payload should be interpreted as text or JSON based on content type header.
